description: Deterministic blueprint-strategy seed feeds. Always ingested by expanded_sources.py Phase 2 every weekly run, regardless of whether the Opus Phase-1 discovery run (paper_expansion_ingestor.js) succeeds. These are sites that publish EXPLICIT, reproducible rule-based daily-equity/ETF strategy blueprints (entry/exit/params + author backtests) — a higher implementation hit-rate than academic papers alone. Provenance: docs/research/strategy-blueprint-sources.md (2026-06-16). RSS feeds (kind:'rss') verified one-post-per-item (real article title + link to original post) on 2026-06-16. HTML index feeds (kind:'html', Phase 4 2026-06-16) carry a per-source 'link_pattern' regex matching strategy-page URLs on the index — these are clean-URL sites whose anchors lack the .pdf/.htm extension RX_PAPER_LINK requires, so they use _parse_html_index_pattern instead; each link_pattern verified against the live index HTML (curl + browser UA) on 2026-06-16. NOTE: Quantocracy (digest hub — its RSS emits roundup stubs, not articles) stays steered via the Opus discovery prompt (EXPANSION_PROMPT_PREAMBLE), NOT seeded. To disable all seeds without a code change: set OPENCLAW_BLUEPRINT_SEEDS=0 in .env, or pass --no-seeds.

sources.name: Quantified Strategies
sources.notes: Oddmund Groette — closest oxfordstrat analog; explicit entry/exit + params + backtest, heavy SPY/QQQ/sector daily. One post/item, abstract in description.

sources.name: Robot Wealth
sources.notes: Kris Longmore — explicit edges + code, daily equity/ETF (+crypto). One post/item.

sources.name: Alvarez Quant Trading
sources.notes: Cesar Alvarez (ex-Connors) — full daily US-equity mean-reversion rules published free. One post/item; source_url carries a stable utm tail (dedup keys on full URL, harmless).

sources.name: TuringTrader
sources.notes: Per-strategy portfolio pages with full numeric rules + author backtests; clean extension-less URLs (/portfolios/<slug>/). Static-HTML index verified 2026-06-16 (3 strategy cards on the static page; anchor text 'Learn More'). link_pattern excludes the bare /portfolios/ index + nav/footer + ?x= filter chips.

sources.name: Quantpedia (free)
sources.notes: Free strategy encyclopedia; /screener server-renders 82 /strategies/<slug> links in static HTML (Next.js, but anchors are in SSR markup) verified 2026-06-16. link_pattern excludes /screener, /blog, /pricing, /_next nav. Per-strategy pages give a free summary + rule sketch (full backtest is paywalled, but the rule description is enough for PaperHunter).
